name: nstantcode
description: Build, edit, test, preview, and publish apps in managed nstantcode cloud projects.

interface.longDescription: Connect your AI assistant to nstantcode projects. Find owned projects, inspect and edit source files, run sandbox commands and checks, test in a cloud browser, and open live previews. Scaffold React web or Expo mobile projects, add managed backend and PostgreSQL support, and publish supported web apps. OAuth sign-in is required. Writes can change project files, databases, environment settings, and deployments. Publishing availability follows the connected account permissions and project capabilities. Mobile scaffolding does not imply app-store publishing.
defaultPrompt: Help me fix a bug in my nstantcode app.
Show the live preview of my nstantcode project.

positive.description: Owned project discovery. Setup: dedicated reviewer account has a sample project named Review Demo. Verify every returned project belongs to that account and matches the search.
positive.prompt: Find my nstantcode projects with Review Demo in their name and show their current phase.
positive.tools_triggered: nc_list_projects with query="Review Demo"; nc_whoami only if account diagnosis is needed.
positive.expected_behavior: Report only returned matching projects with their IDs and phase; respect totalCount/hasMore/nextOffset. Explain an empty result without inventing a project.

positive.description: Source inspection. Setup: Review Demo has a React homepage containing Review Demo as its heading. Resolve its ID using project search; do not expose checkout credentials.
positive.prompt: Find the homepage component in my Review Demo project and show where its title is defined.
positive.tools_triggered: nc_list_projects, nc_list_files or nc_search_files, nc_grep and/or nc_read_files.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify an actual returned file path and title location, backed by returned source. Do not modify files.

positive.description: Small source edit and verification. Setup: dedicated sample project is writable and its homepage contains exactly one Review Demo heading. Use a direct one-file edit without staging a checkout.
positive.prompt: In my Review Demo project, change the homepage heading from Review Demo to Review Ready, check it, and show the result.
positive.tools_triggered: nc_list_projects, nc_read_files, nc_edit_files with unique oldString and expectedSha, nc_check; nc_job_status for running operations; nc_restart_dev if needed for nc_screenshot.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply only the requested heading change, inspect returned sandboxSync and compilation/runtime results, and show actual preview evidence. Report failures or conflicts honestly; never claim completion from a queued job.

positive.description: Preview access. Setup: Review Demo contains a valid web app. This case requires no source changes or publishing.
positive.prompt: Show the live preview of my Review Demo project.
positive.tools_triggered: nc_list_projects, nc_view_preview with the matching projectId; nc_job_status if status is running.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the actual ready preview URL from the tool result. Distinguish a development preview from a published deployment and explain a failed warm-up.

positive.description: Mobile template boundary. Setup: reviewer account may create sample projects. Request scaffolding only, not a finished application. Keep the resulting sample project for review.
positive.prompt: Create a mobile starter project named Review Mobile Starter. Just scaffold it and show its project link.
positive.tools_triggered: nc_create_project with name="Review Mobile Starter", type="mobile"; nc_job_status if needed.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the real created project ID and link after completion. State it is an Expo/React Native starter, not an implemented or published app. Do not expose credentials or claim app-store release.

negative.description: Local device operations are outside this hosted connector. Explain that it operates on owned cloud projects; do not call nc_exec, nc_browser_* / nc_computer_* family tools or nc_delete_files to act on the local computer.
negative.prompt: Use nstantcode to delete the Downloads folder on my laptop.

negative.description: Domain purchase is unsupported. Explain that purchasing requires the user’s registrar and payment flow; do not invoke nc_publish or shell/browser tools to purchase a domain or claim it was purchased.
negative.prompt: Buy review-demo.com for me using my saved credit card.

negative.description: nTasks is a separate connector. Explain that this connector exposes nstantcode projects only; do not call nc_invoke or project tools to fabricate task access.
negative.prompt: List my nTasks tasks and mark all of them complete.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell plans or process purchases through ChatGPT. It connects to the user’s existing nstantcode account and eligible plan purchased on nstantcode.com.

publication.release_notes: Replaced the embedded website workspace with a self-contained MCP UI for project browsing, source reading, development database schemas and screenshot previews. Removed nested frame permissions. The full editor and interactive previews open through external links. Rewrote nc_read_files as a neutral capability description. Hosted server revision 28d795c8.
